description: Defines the interface and class for StableVideoDecoderService, an adapter for video decoding in media Mojo services, including method declarations, class members, and external dependencies.

classes.name: StableVideoDecoderService
classes.description: An adapter class implementing video decoding interfaces for media Mojo services, managing communication between different Mojo interfaces and in-process video decoder.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with client remote, media log, handle releaser, data pipe, and color space.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with specific configuration, low delay flag, and CDM context.

methods.name: ReleaseVideoFrame
methods.description: Releases a video frame identified by a token.

methods.name: OnVideoFrameDecoded
methods.description: Handles a decoded video frame event.

methods.name: RequestOverlayInfo
methods.description: Requests overlay information, possibly for transitions.

methods.name: AddLogRecord
methods.description: Adds a log record to media log.
